description:
Classic Harbor Line Boston offers some of the best views of the Winthrop fireworks show  for the 4th of July in Boston. Our Boston fireworks cruise aboard Yacht Northern Lights is great for friends and family or groups looking to celebrate in Boston on the 4th of July. Join us off of Winthrop, MA, just across the Boston Harbor for a spectacular fireworks display - rated as one of the top things to do in Boston for the 4th of July! 

This special 3-hour Boston boat cruise gives guests the opportunity to see this sparkling fireworks display from the comfort of our classic boat. Yacht Northern Lights features an upper top deck that’s open, along with a climate controlled grand salon with wrap-around windows. Both spaces are great for watching the fireworks on this Boston 4th of July Cruise. There’s also a full bar with drinks and light snacks available for purchase by credit card. So sit back and relax with us aboard our classic 1920s style yacht and marvel at the best fireworks in Boston. 

****************************

***Northern Lights will run in light rain, however, the Winthrop Fireworks are weather permitting*** 

***Note, we view the fireworks in Winthrop, MA, these are not the Boston Pop Fireworks on the Charles River. Our boats are too large to go up the Charles River, but we find the fireworks in Winthrop to be just as good of a show and far less crowded for better viewing.***

****************************

##Notable sites:
- See the beautiful Boston Skyline and iconic waterfront sites as we cruise out of Boston Harbor. 
- Seaport district buildings with their colorful 4th of July décor. 
- Of course, an amazing fireworks display

##About Northern Lights  
A Coast Guard Certified Captains and extremely friendly and knowledgeable crew who are trained to help in the event of an emergency operate Northern Lights. The motor yacht Northern Lights is stylized after the classic New England 1920s style steamships. She is one of the most comfortable and versatile cruise vessels in Boston Harbor. Northern Lights is 115-feet in length, features six bathrooms, and provides ample seating throughout the ship for up to 149 passengers. She is built for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures. Thus, she is excellent for taking out groups of friends and family to see the harbor. Sit back and relax in our climate-controlled (heating and air conditioning) cabin or enjoy the sea breeze on our open top deck. Be sure to visit our fully stocked bar on the main deck to purchase refreshments.
